notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Evangel of Heliod.
Your devotion to white is at least four.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Evangel of Heliod.
The Evangel of Heliod token triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Soldier creature tokens equal to your devotion to white.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five creature tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
